criteria.description: One hero heading, one description, one email field, one submit CTA, one terms link, one media figure; zero nav toggles, drawers, or second CTAs
Email signup form validates and submits without navigation; terms link is a real anchor; no disclosure open state required by source
Exactly one primary CTA button; media is a peer column not a background; no duplicate interactive controls
Copy-then-media stack on narrow; two-column side-by-side on wide; no root overflow at 320/390/767/768/1280
JavaScript-disabled view keeps email field, submit control, terms link, and media reachable in normal flow
Visible labels and focus, fully visible 44px targets, reduced motion, light/dark tokens, axe WCAG 2.1 AA
Codex reviewed fresh desktop, tablet, mobile, dark, and JavaScript-disabled captures
